name: ChatView mobile
description:
1. Goal: allow users to upload local files as message attachments, mirroring the existing image-paste flow.
2. Added an "Upload files" dropdown entry plus a hidden multi-select `<input type="file">` in `ChatInputToolbar.vue`.
3. Forwarded the new `upload-files` event through `ChatInputBox.vue` to the parent chat component.
4. Handled the event in `Chat.vue` via `onUploadFiles`, converting each file with `ChatAttachment.fromFile` into `this.attachments`.
5. Reused the existing 50 MB size guard (error text generalized) and left drag/drop and the project-file modal untouched.

messages.content: We must allow to upload files to the message like when user pastes an image

I'll start by analyzing the codebase to understand how attachments work currently and how to implement file uploads to messages. ``` Read 3 file(s) | Successfully read: src/api/model/ChatAttachment.js, src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue, src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue ``` ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me examine more related files to understand the full flow and existing patterns. ``` Search completed: 6 queries executed, 60 documents found ``` ``` Read 2 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue, src/store/chats.js ``` # Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements:** Allow the user to upload local files from disk so they are attached to the message being composed — exactly the same behaviour as pasting an image (i.e. stored as `ChatAttachment` objects in `this.attachments`, rendered by `ChatAttachmentPreview`, and sent in the message `attachments` payload). **Strategic Approach:** 1. Add an **"Upload files"** entry to the composer's options dropdown (`ChatInputToolbar.vue`) backed by a hidden ``. 2. Emit the picked files upward (`upload-files`), forwarding through `ChatInputBox.vue`. 3. Handle them in `Chat.vue` by converting each file into a `ChatAttachment` (reusing the existing `prepareAttachmentFromFile`) and pushing into `this.attachments` — identical to the image-paste flow. **Dependencies & Risks:** - `ChatAttachment.fromFile` base64-encodes any file, so large files inflate the message. We reuse the existing size guard (`validateImageSize`, 50 MB) — its error text is generalized. - The existing drag/drop project-upload flow (`uploadLocalFiles` → project `/upload`) is **untouched**; only a new explicit picker is added. **Target Files:** | File | Action | | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue` | Modify | | `src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue` | Modify | | Behaviour Summary - **New UX entry point:** Composer options dropdown → **"Upload files"** opens the OS file picker (multi-select). - **Same pipeline as image paste:** Each chosen file → `ChatAttachment.fromFile` → `this.attachments` → rendered in `ChatAttachmentPreview` → serialized in `getUserMessage({ attachments })` on send and in `updateMessage()` when editing. - **Guard rails:** Files over 50 MB are rejected with a notification (reusing the existing size check). - **No regressions:** The existing project-file `Attach files` modal and drag/drop project upload flows are left
